title: Illustration of the card holder on the circuit board
body_md: The illustration shows a section of the circuit board with the opened holder for the nano SIM card and the card lying next to it. A yellow warning symbol for electrostatically sensitive devices is overlaid on the image; the board must therefore only be touched at its edges and not on the components.
source_region: Section 2.2, photo in the lower third
prev_context: Before this stands the instruction to insert and lock the card.
next_context: Section 2.3 on the app follows on the next page.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 13: the same unchanged illustration without a caption in both versions. The symbol is put into words here because the source never spells out its meaning; the derived handling rule is marked as such and needs technical confirmation.
